title.narrative: Fostering and expanding cross-border cooperation between Israeli and Palestinian professionals working in the field of children with disabilities

description.narrative: This action aims at building mutual confidence and civil society cooperation between Palestinian and Israeli professionals and institutions working in the field of disabilities. In particular, the project will provide educational and rehabilitation services as we as employment trainings in the field of autism spectrum and cognitive disabilities.
